note_en: The pattern 一……就…… means "as soon as… then…": 为什么火一点着就有烟？ "Why is there smoke as soon as a fire is lit?" and 我一看到烟，就会想…… "the moment I see smoke, I think…" Unlike English, both markers sit right before the verbs, and the subject can go before 一.
